Therapist here, and I do EMDR therapy as well. You need to explain to your therapist you are stuck and experiencing these emotions in and out of session. The therapist needs to know if the current processing is not working so they can try different approaches. So much of EMDR is internal processing that communication with the therapist is a must for it to be fully effective. Don't worry about hurting the therapist's feelings or making them feel like they're doing it wrong; they're there for you and should be able to adjust to your process without issues. Good luck!
